summary: This is a September 20, 2022 Illusions Fence Post Blog article titled 'The Illusions Advantage', which explains the ASTM F964-13 vinyl fence testing specification and how Illusions Vinyl Fence products meet it. It covers the PVC materials and manufacturing class, weathering and quality assurance testing, and promotes the product's styles, colors, woodgrains and U.S. manufacture by Eastern Wholesale Fence. Most of the page is website navigation, footer links and contact-form boilerplate, which were ignored.
one_line: Illusions Fence blog post explaining how its vinyl fence meets the ASTM F964-13 testing standard for PVC profiles.
key_facts: ASTM F964-13 is described as the "end all, beat all" testing specification for vinyl fence.
The purpose of ASTM F964-13 is to establish a recognized standard of quality for exterior vinyl profiles used in agricultural, commercial, and residential fencing and railing.
Illusions Vinyl Fence products are manufactured using Rigid Poly Vinyl Chloride (PVC) compounds that meet ASTM Specification D4216.
Illusions Vinyl Fence products are manufactured to meet cell Class 3–30233–23 as defined in Specification D4216.
The PVC compound shall have a minimum impact resistance of 0.6 in.-lb/mil (2670 J/m) after weathering six months and one year in hot, dry, hot humid, and temperate northern climates.

Color and consistency testing covers weathering at six months and one year for white, and six months, one year, and two years for all other colors, in Phoenix, AZ, Miami, FL, and a temperate northern climate.
Quality assurance dimensional tests are run at the startup of a production run and every two hours thereafter.
Bond testing and capstock thickness testing are done at startup of production and once per shift, with a minimum of two tests per 24 hours of production.
All Illusions products are described as 100% pure virgin vinyl, VMA certified, and ASTM F964 compliant.
Illusions products are manufactured by Eastern Wholesale Fence of Medford, NY, which the article says means they are made in the USA.
The article states that the mix 'n' match colors and woodgrains look like authentic stained wood fence and painted wood fence, without the maintenance.
The Illusions product line includes privacy, semi-privacy, board-on-board, Classic Victorian picket, contemporary picket, ornamental picket, post & rail, lattice, arbors and pergolas styles.
